s1.title: 1. Acceptance and company identification
s1.content: These Terms govern your use of the Corvo dashboard, API, documentation and related services (the Service), operated by Greenflow Desenvolvimento de Software LTDA, CNPJ 61.469.487/0001-40 (Greenflow or Corvo). By creating an account or using the Service, you accept these Terms. If you act for an organization, you must be authorized to represent it. s2.title: 2. What the Service provides
s2.content: Corvo lets you integrate the issuance and management of Brazilian electronic service invoices (NFS-e) into your software. The Service includes issuer company registration, certificate management, status tracking, access to XML and PDF when available, document delivery by email and webhooks. Issuance is asynchronous: confirmation that a request was submitted does not mean the invoice was authorized. Check the result through the API, dashboard or webhooks. The test environment produces documents with no fiscal validity and does not consume the production allowance. The current scope is NFS-e; goods invoices (NF-e) and consumer invoices (NFC-e) are not included.

s3.title: 3. Account, workspace and access
s3.content: Keep account and workspace information accurate and current. You must control workspace access, assign appropriate permissions and protect your email, sessions, API keys and webhook secrets. Do not expose credentials in browser applications or public repositories. Notify Corvo of suspected unauthorized access. You are responsible for authorized use of your account, without excluding Greenflow’s responsibility for failures attributable to it.

s4.title: 4. Fiscal responsibilities
s4.content: You must be authorized to issue invoices for registered companies and verify issuer, customer, service, amount, tax, fiscal code, tax regime and municipality information. You must meet registration, accreditation and eligibility requirements imposed by the tax authority and track authorizations, rejections and pending requests. Corvo provides integration technology; fiscal and accounting decisions must be checked with the professionals responsible. A rejection, outage or test document does not replace your fiscal obligations.

s5.title: 5. Digital certificates
s5.content: Where an integration requires an A1 digital certificate, upload only a valid certificate belonging to the issuer company or a representative authorized for the operation. By uploading it, you authorize its use, together with the supplied password, to sign and transmit the fiscal operations you request through the Service. Keep the certificate valid and replace it when needed. Deactivating a certificate in Corvo prevents its further use in the Service; you must request revocation with the issuing certification authority separately.

s6.title: 6. Acceptable use and abuse prevention
s6.content: Do not use the Service to issue false documents, act without company authorization, commit fraud, send spam, distribute unlawful content or violate third-party rights. Do not bypass allowances, company limits, request limits, access controls or free first-invoice eligibility rules, including through accounts or workspaces created for that purpose. Do not share API access beyond your contracted permissions or interfere with the Service or connected fiscal systems.

s7.title: 7. Plans, allowances and renewal
s7.content: The Solo, Equipe, Empresa and Escala plans set the monthly invoice allowance shown in the offer and in the dashboard. Every account gets one free first invoice, once and without renewal, and does not need a plan to issue it. Test (sandbox) invoices are free, unlimited and do not use any allowance. On paid plans the allowance follows the monthly period shown in the dashboard; on the annual plan it renews every month for the 12 months. Allowances belong to the workspace, not to each member or API key. Unused plan invoices do not roll over or convert to money. When the allowance runs out, issuing is blocked until renewal, a plan change or a purchase of single invoices. Without a plan (single invoices only) the account can have 1 active company in production; the recurring plans allow unlimited companies.

s8.title: 8. How usage and single invoices work
s8.content: Each production NFS-e authorized uses one invoice. When a request arrives, Corvo reserves one invoice while the issuance is in progress: from the plan allowance first and, once it is spent, from the single-invoice balance. Rejected or failed issuances give the reservation back; invoices still processing may temporarily reduce the available capacity. If authorization happens after the cycle changes, usage stays in the period where it was reserved. There is no overage billing: nothing is charged for usage beyond the allowance. Single invoices cost R$ 0.99 each, in purchases of at least 3, never expire and are used after the plan allowance.

s9.title: 9. Billing, plan changes and cancellation
s9.content: Plans are sold in Brazilian reais, on a monthly or annual cycle. Monthly renews automatically until cancelled (card, through Stripe, or Pix Automático, through Woovi). Annual is paid at once with 30% off the monthly price and does not renew on its own. Single invoices and the annual plan can also be paid by Pix (one-time charge, valid for 24 hours) or card. Activation depends on payment confirmation. While a paid plan is active, a new plan can only be bought at renewal; single invoices can be bought at any time. Plan changes and cancellation take effect at the end of the current period, without proration. For Pix Automático, cancelling in the dashboard stops future charges and keeps the period already paid. If a renewal fails, plan issuing may continue for up to seven days after the paid period ends and then be blocked; single invoices stay available. Not using the account does not cancel the subscription. Refund or dispute requests can be sent to the contact in these Terms; mandatory statutory rights remain, including the right of withdrawal where applicable.

s10.title: 10. Fiscal documents and retention
s10.content: Corvo stores issuance records and the XML and PDF documents it generates or receives, making them available according to invoice status and your access permissions. Document generation or retrieval failures may require further processing. Storage in the Service does not promise indefinite retention or a specific fiscal retention period unless expressly agreed in a separate contract. Keep your own copies and download documents while you have access to the Service. You remain responsible for retaining documents for the period required for your activity. Export, access or deletion requests after termination are handled under the Privacy Notice, legal obligations and contracted conditions.

s11.content: Issuance depends on integration coverage, company eligibility, valid certificates and the availability of the national or municipal fiscal systems involved. Sending an email or webhook does not guarantee receipt at the destination; track status and configure your integration to query results and handle failures. s9.content: Upon Service termination, the customer may request access, export or deletion of personal data under its responsibility through the privacy contact. Greenflow will comply with lawful instructions under contracted conditions and applicable law. Data requiring retention on a lawful basis will have access restricted to the corresponding purpose; backup deletion will follow the maintenance cycle and applicable obligations. The customer must retain copies of fiscal documents required for its activity. Account closure does not cancel documents with the tax authority.

s10.title: 10. International transfers and contact
s10.content: Where processing involves an international transfer, the parties must follow the mechanisms and safeguards required by the LGPD and applicable regulations. This Addendum alone does not replace standard contractual clauses or another instrument required for a specific transfer. LandingFaq.title: Frequently asked questions
LandingFaq.description: What people ask most before integrating NFS-e issuance.

coverage.q: Does Corvo cover my company's municipality?
coverage.a: Corvo issues through the NFS-e national environment, run by the Receita Federal. The municipalities already on the national standard are listed in the documentation, searchable by name, state or IBGE code. Being on the list does not guarantee that every invoice is accepted: the Receita decides.

issues.q: Does Corvo issue the invoice for me?
issues.a: Yes. You send the sale data through the API, or through a payment integration, and Corvo builds the invoice, signs it with the company's A1 certificate (not needed in test), sends it to the Receita and returns the result. If you want, it also emails the PDF and XML to your customer. Today Corvo serves MEI and Simples Nacional companies.

companies.q: Can I issue invoices for more than one CNPJ on Corvo?
companies.a: Yes. The recurring plans (Solo, Equipe, Empresa and Escala) have unlimited companies, each with its own certificate and its own usage, without building a new integration for each one. With single invoices only, no plan, the account has 1 company.

payments.q: Which payment platforms does Corvo integrate with?
payments.a: Corvo integrates with Woovi and AbacatePay. Once connected, every approved payment becomes an NFS-e automatically, with no code. If there is a refund, the invoice can be cancelled on its own, if you turn that option on.

sdks.q: Does Corvo have an SDK for my language or an MCP server for AI agents?
sdks.a: Yes. Corvo has official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, Rust, Java, Elixir and .NET, with the same operations in all of them, and you can also call the REST API directly. For AI agents, Corvo has an MCP server: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf and Claude Desktop connect with a browser login, and you pick the workspace and the environment (test or live) on the approval screen.
